fusions.name: Full-Weight Slam
fusions.desc: You lunge at a target up to 5 tiles away and drop your weight on it, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range, and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Thrashing Weight
fusions.desc: You roll your full weight over every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 26 damage. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Brumation
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Fat Reserves
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 15, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
